_comment: Generative parameters for the merged TCIT simulation pipeline. These values are calibrated to the statistics of GSE63525 (Rao et al. 2014, K562 chromosome 1) and ENCODE RNA-seq (ENCSR000AEN), consistent with the manuscript submitted to PLOS Computational Biology (PCOMPBIOL-D-26-01280): exponential distance decay (amplitude 2.0, length 8 bins), background contact 0.01, intra-TAD enrichment kappa = 3.0, multiplicative Gamma noise (shape 2.0, mean 1), planted TAD sizes of 6-15 bins, 15-bin feature windows, TAD-enrichment decay length of 3 bins, and regression ground truth standardized on H0/contact-frequency/TAD-enrichment with target R^2 0.72. All seeds are fixed for full reproducibility.

sensitivity._note: noise_sigma is the residual standard deviation in absolute units of expression, applied when regenerating the response during the noise-sensitivity run.
